01 — THE MODERN CLASSIC
01The modern classic+

Let an ivory saree take centre stage. Add a fitted blouse, a low bun, and one sculptural gold piece.

  • Jewellery: a single statement earring
  • Pallu: open and softly draped
  • Finishing touch: a warm nude lip
02The festive romantic+

Lean into the warmth of vermilion with antique-inspired gold and flowers tucked into your hair.

  • Jewellery: layered gold or a choker
  • Pallu: generous, with the border visible
  • Finishing touch: a small red bindi
03The evening statement+

Pair a deep cobalt drape with clean lines and cool metallic accents for an evening silhouette.

  • Jewellery: silver cuffs or drop earrings
  • Pallu: narrow, crisp shoulder pleats
  • Finishing touch: sleek, pulled-back hair

KEEP THE STORY BEAUTIFUL

A little care.
A lasting love.

Thoughtful rituals for your favourite drapes.

How should I store my saree?+

Keep it in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. A breathable cotton bag helps protect it from dust. Gently refold from time to time to avoid keeping the same creases.

How do I care for delicate borders?+

Avoid spraying perfume directly onto metallic details. Let fragrance dry before dressing, and keep jewellery edges clear of loose threads. Always follow the garment’s care label.

What is the best way to prepare a drape?+

Plan your pleats before dressing and use smooth, covered pins where needed. For pressing or cleaning, follow the specific fabric care instructions or consult a professional.

How can I choose a look for an occasion?+

Start with the time of day and how you want to feel. Light tones work beautifully in daylight; deeper jewel colours make an expressive evening choice. Explore our styling room for finishing touches.
